title: 第518章 长河当中牌匾第517章 已经绝迹的灵物遍地都是
slug: 多子多福家族帮我攻略极品仙子
lines: “帝子大人！
不可！”
见到江渊身上升腾起一股霸道绝伦的创生道韵，似乎准备强行干预，一旁的洛长风花容失色，连忙出声阻止。
她一边拼命催动【虚幻梦体】试图帮妹妹稳住神魂，一边焦急地大喊：
“梦境世界与现实不同，那是纯粹的意识与法则交汇之地！
任何现实中的力量，进入其中都会被十倍、百倍地削弱！
即便是大帝境的伟力，在那里面也犹如泥牛入海，极易被同化！
帝子大人，快切断长云的神魂联系，大不了……大不了那一缕神魂不要了！”
洛长风的心在滴血。
分魂梦神体一旦失去这一缕入梦的神魂，洛长云又会回到那种记忆不断重置、心智残缺的痛苦轮回中。
但比起让江渊这位江家帝子涉险，她别无选择。
只要江渊还在，妹妹的神魂就不会有大事。
可反过来，一旦江渊出事，那必然是捅破天的大事！
“无妨。”
江渊的声音平淡，却带着不容置疑的自信。
那双深邃的眼眸中，紫金色的光芒骤然爆发。
大帝境七重天巅峰的恐怖威压，在这一刻毫无保留地释放出来。
整个天帝行宫的虚空都为之震颤，仿佛承受不住这股怒火。
他抬起手，掌心之中，紫金色的鸿蒙创生之气凝聚成一根纤细却坚韧的丝线。
“区区梦境壁垒，也妄图削弱本帝的力量？给本帝开！”
江渊根本没有理会洛长风的警告，他抬起右手，并指如剑，指尖萦绕着纯粹到极致的创生紫气与毁灭雷霆，对着虚空中的那片梦境长河，狠狠一划！
嗤啦——！
一声仿佛布帛被撕裂的刺耳声响彻天际。
那原本只存在于洛长云天赋感知中的梦境长河，竟被江渊以无上伟力，硬生生在现实中撕开了一道巨大的豁口！
“大哥哥！”
洛长云的神魂在旋涡边缘苦苦挣扎，看到江渊那宛如天神降临般的身影，忍不住大声呼喊。
“别怕，哥哥来接你。”
江渊一步跨出，身形瞬间化作一道流光，直接冲入了那道被撕裂的梦境豁口之中。
轰！
刚一踏入梦境世界，江渊便感觉到了一股极其诡异的拉扯力。
四周的空间仿佛是由无数破碎的琉璃拼凑而成，每一块琉璃里都闪烁着不同的画面：有神魔喋血，有星辰陨落，有万物复苏。
这里的确如洛长风所言，现实的法则在这里受到了极大的压制，甚至连大帝级别的气血之力，都变得有些迟滞。
“雕虫小技。”
江渊嘴角勾起一抹狂傲的冷笑。
《鸿蒙创世诀》疯狂运转，紫金色的创生紫气化作一件无懈可击的道铠，将那些试图侵蚀他的混乱法则尽数弹开。
他逆着那股恐怖的吸力，瞬间来到了洛长云的神魂身旁。
“给本帝……过来！”
江渊眼底闪过一抹不耐，手腕轻轻一抖。
轰！
那根纤细的紫金丝线骤然爆发出万丈光芒，创生大道那至高无上的法则之力，如同一轮紫金色的太阳，在梦境长河中轰然炸开！
那漆黑的旋涡，在这股力量的冲击下发出一声无声的哀鸣，竟被硬生生撑开，吸力骤然减弱。
洛长云的神魂小手终于得以松开那柄断戟，被紫金丝线一卷，瞬间拉回了现实。
小丫头脸色煞白，神魂受到了不小的冲击，直接在江渊怀里昏睡了过去。
“长云！”
content_en:
"Your Majesty the Emperor!
No! "
Seeing Jiang Yuan's body rising with a domineering Taoist Rhythm of Creation, as if he was about to intervene forcefully, Luo Changfeng beside him turned pale and quickly spoke out to stop him.
While she was desperately activating the [Illusory Dream Body] to help her sister stabilize her soul, she shouted anxiously:
“The dream world is different from reality, it is the place where pure consciousness and laws meet!
Any power in reality will be weakened ten times or a hundred times if it enters it!
Even the mighty power of the Great Emperor is like a mud cow entering the sea, easily assimilated!
Lord Emperor, cut off the connection between Changyun’s soul and soul. The worst... the worst is that we won’t have that ray of soul anymore! "
Luo Changfeng's heart was bleeding.
Once the Soul-Split Dream Divine Body loses this ray of soul that enters the dream, Luo Changyun will return to the painful reincarnation where his memory is constantly reset and his mind is incomplete.
But she had no choice but to put Jiang Yuan, the emperor of the Jiang family, in danger.
As long as Jiang Yuan is still there, nothing will happen to my sister's soul.
But on the other hand, once something happens to Jiang Yuan, it will definitely be a big deal!
"It doesn't matter."
Jiang Yuan's voice was calm, but filled with unquestionable confidence.
In those deep eyes, purple-gold light suddenly burst out.
The terrifying pressure at the peak of the seventh heaven of the Great Emperor Realm was released without reservation at this moment.
The entire void in the Emperor's palace trembled, as if it could not bear the anger.
He raised his hand, and in his palm, the purple-gold Hongmeng's creation energy condensed into a slender but tough thread.
"A mere dream barrier is trying to weaken this emperor's power? Open it to me!"
Jiang Yuan ignored Luo Changfeng's warning at all. He raised his right hand and pointed it like a sword. The extremely pure purple energy of creation and thunder of destruction lingered on his fingertips, and he slashed hard at the long river of dreams in the void!
Tsk-!
A harsh sound like cloth being torn resounded through the sky.
The long river of dreams that originally existed only in Luo Changyun's innate perception was actually torn open by Jiang Yuan's supreme power to create a huge gap in reality!
"Big brother!"
Luo Changyun's soul was struggling hard on the edge of the vortex. When he saw Jiang Yuan's figure that looked like a god descending from heaven, he couldn't help but shout loudly.
"Don't be afraid, brother will come to pick you up."
Jiang Yuan took a step forward, and his figure instantly turned into a stream of light, rushing directly into the torn gap in the dream.
boom!
As soon as he entered the dream world, Jiang Yuan felt an extremely strange pulling force.
The surrounding space seemed to be made up of countless broken glass, with different scenes flashing in each piece of glass: gods and demons bleeding, stars falling, and all things reviving.
It is indeed as Luo Changfeng said here, the laws of reality are greatly suppressed here, and even the power of Qi and blood at the emperor level has become somewhat sluggish.
"Little tricks."
An arrogant sneer appeared at the corner of Jiang Yuan's mouth.
The "Hongmeng Creation Technique" was running wildly, and the purple-gold purple energy of creation turned into an impeccable Tao armor, which bounced away all the laws of chaos that tried to erode him.
He went against the terrifying suction force and instantly came to Luo Changyun's soul.
"Give me this emperor... come here!"
A flash of impatience flashed in Jiang Yuan's eyes, and he shook his wrist slightly.
boom!
That slender purple-gold thread suddenly burst into light, and the supreme power of the law of the Avenue of Creation exploded in the long river of dreams like a purple-gold sun!
The dark vortex let out a silent cry under the impact of this force, and was forced open, and the suction force suddenly weakened.
Luo Changyun's soulful little hand was finally able to let go of the broken halberd, and was instantly brought back to reality by being rolled up by the purple gold thread.
The little girl's face turned pale, her soul was greatly shocked, and she fell asleep directly in Jiang Yuan's arms.
"Changyun!"
